inflection_point.label: Where this is heading
inflection_point.headline: Platforms are converging on the same capabilities.
inflection_point.body1: AI-assisted development and low-code are converging fast. Most platforms are building the same capabilities into their core: compliance controls, AI integration, agentic workflows. That convergence makes the platform itself less of a differentiator than it used to be.
inflection_point.body2: What still varies enormously between organisations is the foundation underneath the platform — governance, architecture discipline, and the ability to scale past the first few applications. That gap doesn't close on its own.
inflection_point.body3: This is where I focus: helping organisations build that foundation, independent of which platform they land on.
inflection_point.footnote: Not sure where your organisation stands? Take the assessment below.

problem.headline: Start is the easy part.
problem.body: Most organisations adopt the right platform. Momentum builds early, then stalls. Complexity accumulates, standards don't exist, and no one can agree on what to prioritise. The platform gets the blame. The real gap is strategic — knowing which problems to solve, and in what order, to unlock the most value.
problem.punchline: We know how to find those problems. And how to build the path forward.

about.label: About
about.headline: Transformation expertise for organisations that need to get it right.
about.body: I've worked with enterprise IT teams across APAC and Europe — defining strategies, governing platforms at scale, managing complex delivery programmes, and building the organisational foundations that make transformation stick. I built my career inside Mendix and Siemens — starting at Mendix NL, then brought to Seoul in 2022 by Siemens Korea to deliver a worldwide GTM application for a global enterprise client. That engagement rooted me in the region and shaped how I approach the work.
about.body2: A track record with enterprise clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Europe. Working in these markets also means understanding the local dynamics — how decisions move, how consensus forms, and where relationship trust shapes every programme. English and Dutch. Remote-first, and happy to travel when it matters. Open to both project-based engagements and the right full-time role — whichever fits the problem best.
about.body3: I work directly with platform partners and system integrators who need senior capacity on complex engagements. If you need experienced backup on a delivery, reach out.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Common questions.
faq.q1: What does a Maturity Assessment include?
faq.a1: A structured review across six dimensions: platform usage, team capability, governance, architecture, AI readiness, and organisational maturity. The output is a scored report that I discuss with you — either right away or in a planned follow-up — to pinpoint the topics worth setting up or improving. It's a collaborative starting point, not a document drop.
faq.a2: Yes. I work worldwide, remote-first. I've delivered for clients in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, the Netherlands, and beyond. Large timezone differences are manageable — we discuss upfront how to structure communication so it works for both sides.
faq.q3: Can you work alongside our existing team?
faq.a3: Yes. I do hands-on delivery, work alongside your existing developers, or both. Some clients need me to deliver; others need me to coach and guide their team. Most engagements end up being a mix — I adapt to what the situation actually requires.
faq.q4: How are engagements scoped and priced?
faq.a4: I scope and price after an initial conversation. There's no fixed rate card — engagements vary by size, duration, and complexity. I'll be direct about what makes sense.

social_proof.label: Track record
social_proof.headline: Numbers from the field.
social_proof.engagements_label: Pre-LCW track record · Via Siemens & enterprise platform partners
social_proof.case1_tag: CoE Setup · DX Factory · Partner Enablement
social_proof.case1_desc: Macnica is Japan's leading Mendix partner and one of the country's largest IT distributors. We set up the Macnica DX Factory — a Mendix CoE enabling both internal application development and customer-facing projects. As tech lead, I coached the development teams, embedded Agile ways of working, and set up the technical governance and development processes. The factory became the foundation for Macnica's Mendix practice across Japan.
social_proof.case2_tag: Digital Transformation · CoE Setup · App Development
social_proof.case2_desc: USI Global is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer with 22,000 employees across 30 production sites. I led the Mendix CoE setup and digital transformation — consolidating 10 fragmented legacy systems into a single platform covering 70+ approval workflows. Result: 30% faster development and a unified foundation for enterprise-wide process transformation.
social_proof.case2_cta: Read the full story on Mendix.com
social_proof.case3_desc:
Before founding LCW, I worked inside Mendix and Siemens — enabling 8+ partners across APAC and Europe, and helping close deals through strong presales and PoC cycles. Supported Siemens presales engagements and presented at Mendix community events.

That front-line view across the full partner landscape — how deals are won, where PoCs succeed or stall, what makes a partner effective — is where the pattern recognition I bring today comes from.
social_proof.case4_desc: I inherited a fragmented 120+ app landscape: inconsistent versions, database performance issues, no CI/CD, no maintenance process, organisational silos. I partnered with the technical counterpart and secured Program Owner sponsorship to rebuild the foundation over 18 months. Delivered applications in sustainability and MES.
social_proof.case4_cta: Read the full story on Mendix.com
social_proof.case5_desc: I led the 1.5-year development and delivery of Siemens PCBflow, a secure, cloud-based platform accelerating the design-to-manufacturing handoff for printed circuit boards. Built in collaboration with two global Siemens teams — the Israeli team behind the original product (acquired by Siemens), and a Siemens engineering team in India — to bring it to a successful global launch. Still part of the Siemens portfolio today.
social_proof.case6_desc: I led development of finance applications on top of SAP for nationwide use — serving ~2,500 government users. I supported the purchasing processes of a national infrastructure and water management authority, replacing the previous way of working to improve grip on purchases, budgets, and fraud prevention. I partnered with a major systems integrator to connect the application to several security-sensitive government SAP systems.
social_proof.case6_cta: Read the full story on Mendix.com
